lessons: Criterion 3 is unmet: tests/test_cli.py was never changed. Add a status test. Seed a Box bug_report whose app_commit is a first-parent commit with valid trailers, plus a passing check invoice. Assert the scorecard escapes column counts it once.

Add a Retro.run-level test in tests/test_retro.py using fake Git and a fake driver. Capture the RetroWindow the driver receives and assert escape_attributions == ((signature, ticket),). A direct Window.projection call does not prove Retro passes the attribution.

The ticket says the source is resolved bug_report evidence. Filter out pending (untriaged) and tombstoned (rejected or duplicate) reports in escape_attributions(). Prove it with a test where such a report contributes no escape.

The BASE..HEAD form is untested and passes the literal string to git. Read section 20 of the plan to learn what BASE means. Resolve it to real endpoints on first-parent HEAD ancestry, and add test_git cases for a valid range, a foreign range, and an ambiguous range.
